parameters.label: 生成 adc
parameters.description: compute the mean apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) of the diffusion tensor. (sometimes also referred to as the mean diffusivity (MD))

parameters.label: 生成 fa
parameters.description: compute the fractional anisotropy (FA) of the diffusion tensor.

parameters.label: 生成 ad
parameters.description: compute the axial diffusivity (AD) of the diffusion tensor. (equivalent to the principal eigenvalue)

parameters.label: 生成 rd
parameters.description: compute the radial diffusivity (RD) of the diffusion tensor. (equivalent to the mean of the two non-principal eigenvalues)

parameters.label: 生成 cl
parameters.description: compute the linearity metric of the diffusion tensor. (one of the three Westin shape metrics)

parameters.label: 生成 cp
parameters.description: compute the planarity metric of the diffusion tensor. (one of the three Westin shape metrics)

parameters.label: 生成 cs
parameters.description: compute the sphericity metric of the diffusion tensor. (one of the three Westin shape metrics)

parameters.label: 生成 value
parameters.description: compute the selected eigenvalue(s) of the diffusion tensor.

parameters.label: 生成 vector
parameters.description: compute the selected eigenvector(s) of the diffusion tensor.

parameters.label: num
parameters.description: specify the desired eigenvalue/eigenvector(s). Note that several eigenvalues can be specified as a number sequence. For example, '1,3' specifies the principal (1) and minor (3) eigenvalues/eigenvectors (default = 1).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: modulate
parameters.description: specify how to modulate the magnitude of the eigenvectors. Valid choices are: none, FA, eigval (default = FA).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。
